data.one_liner: Configurable particle emitter for Flutter to create rain, smoke, and physics animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable particle system with support for both deterministic and physics-based animations (powered by Chipmunk2D). It features interactive widget collisions, custom shapes, and an online visual configurator.
use_when: You want to add visual particle effects like rain, snow, confetti, or smoke to your Flutter app.
Particles need to interact and collide with standard Flutter UI widgets.
avoid_when: You require a full-fledged 2D game engine rather than just particle animations.
Targeting web with WASM requires additional script setup.
strengths: Highly configurable particle options and custom shapes.
Chipmunk2D-backed physics integration for realistic gravity and collisions.
Includes a visual interactive configurator with code generation.
weaknesses: Package is under active development with potential breaking changes before 1.0.0.
Requires extra web script setup for WASM builds using physics effects.
data.setup_notes: Requires calling initializeNewton() before running the app. For web with WASM and physics effects, a helper script must be added to web/index.html.
data.minimal_example:
Newton(
  effectConfigurations: [
    PhysicsEffectConfiguration(
      physicsProperties: const PhysicsProperties(
        gravity: Gravity.earthGravity,
        angle: NumRange.single(90),
        velocity: NumRange.between(Velocity.stationary, Velocity.stationary),
      ),
      visualProperties: const VisualProperties(
        endScale: NumRange.single(1),
        fadeOutThreshold: NumRange.between(0.6, 0.8),
      ),
      emissionProperties: const EmissionProperties(
        origin: Offset.zero,
        maxOriginOffset: Offset(1, 0),
        particleLifespan: DurationRange.between(Duration(seconds: 7), Duration(seconds: 10)),
      ),
      particleConfiguration: const ParticleConfiguration(
        shape: CircleShape(),
        size: Size(5, 5),
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
